questions.question: How many customers are there?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM customers

questions.question: How many customers signed up in the last 3 months?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND signup_date <= CURRENT_DATE

questions.question: What is the total revenue from completed orders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

questions.question: List all products in the Electronics category.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, name, category, price FROM products WHERE category ILIKE 'Electronics' ORDER BY id

questions.question: How many orders have the status 'cancelled'?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

questions.question: What is the average order total for completed orders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS value FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

questions.question: How many customers are from Mumbai?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM customers WHERE city ILIKE 'Mumbai'

questions.question: What is the most expensive product?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, name, category, price FROM products WHERE price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products)

questions.question: How many payments failed?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM payments WHERE status = 'failed'

questions.question: List customers who signed up in October 2025.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, name, email, signup_date, city FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND signup_date < DATE '2025-11-01'

questions.question: Who is the best customer?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.id,c.name,c.email,SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.id,c.name,c.email ORDER BY total_spent DESC,c.id LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show me last month's best customer.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.id,c.name,c.email,SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month',CURRENT_DATE)-INTERVAL '1 month' AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month',CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY c.id,c.name,c.email ORDER BY total_spent DESC,c.id LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the top products?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.id,p.name,SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.id,p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC,p.id LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which city has the best customers?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.city,SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY total_spent DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is our most popular product?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.id,p.name,SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.id,p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC,p.id LIMIT 1

questions.question: Who are our most valuable customers?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.id,c.name,SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.id,c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC,c.id LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which product category performs best?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.category,SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show me John's orders.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT o.id,o.customer_id,o.order_date,o.status,o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE c.name='John Iyer' ORDER BY o.id

questions.question: What has John bought?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.id,p.name,SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity_bought FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE c.name='John Iyer' GROUP BY p.id,p.name ORDER BY p.id

questions.question: How much has John spent?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount),0) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE c.name='John Iyer' AND o.status='completed'

questions.question: Show me recent orders.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id,customer_id,order_date,status,total_amount FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL '30 days' AND order_date < CURRENT_DATE+INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY id

questions.question: How many customers signed up recently?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL '30 days' AND signup_date < CURRENT_DATE+INTERVAL '1 day'

questions.question: What were sales like lately?
questions.clarification_answer: Last 30 days, total completed-order revenue by day
questions.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_date::date AS day,SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL '30 days' AND o.order_date < CURRENT_DATE+INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY o.order_date::date ORDER BY day
